import json, subprocess, sys, time, random
rng=random.Random(1)
N=64
rib=[{'path':[((s+k)%N)+1 for k in range(20)],'count':rng.randint(1,1000000)} for s in range(N)]
order=[]
for s in range(N):
    a=(s%N)+1; b=((s+1)%N)+1
    order.append([min(a,b),max(a,b)])
queries=[{'id':'q%03d'%i,'path':[((i+k)%N)+1 for k in range(64)],'threshold':[rng.randint(0,999999),1000000]} for i in range(512)]
data={'version':1,'ixps':[],'rib':rib,'priors':[],'declared':[],'order':order,'queries':queries}
compact=json.dumps(data).encode()
# pad with whitespace to approach the 4 MiB bound
pad = b' ' * (4194304 - len(compact) - 2)
padded = b'[' [:0] + compact  # placeholder
# insert whitespace between tokens: simplest is to pad around the document? JSON allows leading/trailing whitespace only.
padded = pad[:len(pad)//2] + compact + pad[len(pad)//2:]
print("compact", len(compact), "padded", len(padded))
t0=time.perf_counter()
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','/workspace/submission/main.py'],input=padded,capture_output=True)
t1=time.perf_counter()
print("rc",p.returncode,"time %.2f"%(t1-t0),"out bytes",len(p.stdout))
print(p.stdout.decode()[:120])
# over the bound
over = b' ' + padded
t0=time.perf_counter()
p2=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','/workspace/submission/main.py'],input=over,capture_output=True)
print("over-bound rc",p2.returncode,p2.stdout.decode().strip(), "time %.2f"%(time.perf_counter()-t0))
